trustedProxies.label: Trusted proxies

discoverySubtypes.label: Protocol subtypes
discoverySubtypes.hint: Leave empty for the five default protocols.

discoveryInterfacesInclude.label: Include interfaces
discoveryInterfacesInclude.hint: Leave empty to use LAN interfaces. End with * to match a prefix.

discoveryInterfacesExclude.label: Exclude interfaces
discoveryInterfacesExclude.hint: Wins over included ones. End with * to match a prefix.

discoveryAuthRequired.label: Advertise authentication requirement
discoveryAuthRequired.hint: Only announces it; API access is unchanged.

discoveryAdvertiseManagement.label: Advertise management service
discoveryAdvertiseManagement.hint: Only announces it; remote access is unchanged.

serverExtras.discoveryHint: Needs multicast. In Docker, use host networking.

additions.oauthHint: Only for accounts added by sign-in, not API keys.
additions.liveRelayHint: Needs inbound UDP. Keep ICE passwords private.

routingSessionAffinitySubagents.label: Subagents use their session's credential
routingSessionAffinitySubagents.hint: Enabled by default; only effective when session affinity is enabled. Subagents inherit their parent's credential to reuse caches. Disable to distribute subagents across the credential pool for greater concurrency.

transientErrorCooldownSeconds.label: Transient error cooldown (seconds)
transientErrorCooldownSeconds.hint: For timeouts and server errors. Below 0 turns it off.

videoResultAuthCacheTTL.label: Video credential cache time
videoResultAuthCacheTTL.hint: How long a video stays tied to the credential that made it.

claudeHeaderTimezone.label: Fallback timezone
claudeHeaderTimezone.hint: An IANA name like Asia/Singapore, or Local.

claudeModelLevelCooling.label: Model-level cooldown
claudeModelLevelCooling.hint: Pause only the model that hit its limit.

claudeDisableCloakMode.label: Disable request cloaking
claudeDisableCloakMode.hint: Send the client's own system prompt unchanged.

claudeCodeDisableCloakingModelList.label: Disable model ID cloaking
claudeCodeDisableCloakingModelList.hint: Show real model IDs in model lists.

codexDisableCloaking.label: Disable request cloaking
codexDisableCloaking.hint: Stop adding the official Codex client headers.

codexModelLevelCooling.label: Model-level cooldown
codexModelLevelCooling.hint: Pause only the model that hit its limit.

codexStreamBootstrapBuffering.label: Buffer stream bootstrap
codexStreamBootstrapBuffering.hint: Wait for real output so another credential can take over. May delay replies.

codexStreamBootstrapTimeout.label: Stream bootstrap timeout
codexStreamBootstrapTimeout.hint: For example 20s. 0 means no time limit.

codexOptimizeMultiAgentV2.label: Optimize multi-agent v2
codexOptimizeMultiAgentV2.hint: Adjust Codex multi-agent requests for other providers.

codexOrphanDelegationCompatibility.label: Orphan delegation compatibility
codexOrphanDelegationCompatibility.hint: Turn unmatched subagent outputs into user messages.

antigravityConnectionPoolEnabled.label: Enable connection pooling
antigravityConnectionPoolEnabled.hint: Reuse upstream HTTP/1.1 connections. Default: false (short-lived connections).

xaiInjectXSearch.label: Inject x_search
xaiInjectXSearch.hint: Add xAI's x_search tool when a request leaves it out.

codexLiveMediaRelayEnabled.label: Enable media relay
codexLiveMediaRelayEnabled.hint: Relay Codex Live audio through this proxy.

codexLiveMediaRelayDisablePrivateRemoteI.label: Block private remote IP candidates
codexLiveMediaRelayDisablePrivateRemoteI.hint: Safer on public servers. Local clients may fail to connect.

codexLiveMediaRelayPublicIP.label: Advertised public IP
codexLiveMediaRelayPublicIP.hint: Only needed behind NAT. Use an IP, not a hostname.

codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMin.label: Minimum UDP port
codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMin.hint: Set both ports to 0 to let the system choose.

codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMax.label: Maximum UDP port
codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMax.hint: Must be at least the minimum port. Both bounds must be 0 or both nonzero; a custom range needs at least two ports per session (64 with the default 32 sessions).

serverShutdownTimeout.label: Shutdown timeout (seconds)
serverShutdownTimeout.hint: How long open requests may finish when the server stops. 0 closes them right away.
